question: What practice should be maintained continually when the yoginī assembly occurs?
premises: The practice is to be done at all times.
The context is the yoginī assembly.
inference: One should always partake of that when there is an assembly of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The referent of tat depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: One should always partake of that at the proper time when there is an assembly of yoginīs.
